modules.name: Customer Management
modules.description: Manages Society Managers, their permissions, resident registration and approval, flat occupancy and tenancy.

requirements.title: Create or replace Society Manager
requirements.description: Web users can create or replace a Society Manager. On a replacement, the old member loses access and pending items move to members with the same permission.

requirements.title: Permissions per member
requirements.description: Raghuvir Admin can give permissions to each member. A member given Approve residents sees the approval list.

requirements.title: Approve or reject resident
requirements.description: On mobile, a resident can be approved or rejected. A rejection requires a reason and the resident is notified.

requirements.title: Add resident manually
requirements.description: On mobile, a resident can be added manually with valid details. The resident gets access without approval.

requirements.title: Owner or Tenant registration
requirements.description: At registration on mobile, the user picks Owner or Tenant. A tenant also gives owner name and agreement end date.

requirements.title: Flag Flat Already Taken
requirements.description: On web and mobile, a new request for a flat with an active main user is flagged Flat Already Taken.

requirements.title: Flat occupancy status
requirements.description: On web and mobile, every flat shows Owner living, Tenant living or Vacant.

requirements.title: Tenancy end reminder
requirements.description: On web and mobile, the tenant and Society Manager get a reminder 15 days before the agreement ends.

requirements.title: Keep complaint history on owner or tenant change
requirements.description: On mobile, when the old main user is deactivated and a new one is approved, complaint history stays with the flat.

requirements.title: Resident list view for Raghuvir Admin
requirements.description: On web, opening residents shows a view-only list filterable by owner or tenant. This is a Should priority.

rules.title: Last-holder protection
rules.description: If only one member has Approve residents or Check complaints, the system blocks removing that permission from them.

rules.title: One main user per flat
rules.description: A flat can have only one active main user.

rules.title: Tenancy access ends only on confirmation
rules.description: Tenant access ends only after a Society Manager confirms it, not automatically at agreement end.
